mesh_displace_spectrum — 3D terrain op

• Data kinds: mesh → mesh

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mesh_displace_spectrum(V, F, wavelengths=(0.06, 0.03, 0.015, 0.0075, 0.00375), amplitudes=(0.003, 0.00176, 0.00103, 0.0006, 0.00035), *, seed: 'int' = 0, nyquist: 'float' = 2.0, fade: 'float' = 1.0, weights=None, local_edge=None) (to call the implementation directly, import render3d; render3d.mesh_displace_spectrum(V, F, wavelengths=(0.06, 0.03, 0.015, 0.0075, 0.00375), amplitudes=(0.003, 0.00176, 0.00103, 0.0006, 0.00035), *, seed: 'int' = 0, nyquist: 'float' = 2.0, fade: 'float' = 1.0, weights=None, local_edge=None); from the registry, ops3d.get("mesh_displace_spectrum"))

Usage

Displace vertices along their normals with a stated amplitude spectrum, band-limited.

The band limit is per vertex; returns (V, F).

displacement_i = Σ_k A_k · n_k(x_i) · gate_k(i) · w_k(i) with one seeded value-noise octave n_k ∈ [−1, 1] per (wavelength_k, amplitude_k) pair (mesh units — the Itokawa STL is in km, so the default is 3 m at 60 m falling as A ∝ λ^0.77 to 0.35 m at 3.75 m), gate = displacement_band_weights on *this* mesh (an octave shorter than nyquist × local edge is not applied — it would alias into facet noise; route it to bump_normals_fbm instead) and weights = optional (N,) per-vertex or (K, N) per-octave-per-vertex factor in [0,1] (e.g. the synthetic-relief weight 1 − gate of the source model). The peak displacement at a vertex is at most Σ_k A_k (tests pin it). Unlike mesh_displace_fbm (one amplitude, octave ratio 2, no band limit) every octave's amplitude is explicit. Deterministic under seed. Fail-closed on shapes / non-finite / negative values.

Procedure: (1) build gate (K,N) with displacement_band_weights, (2) if weights is given, multiply it in, (3) for each octave k evaluate a seed-fixed value noise n_k(x) ∈ [-1,1] (wavelength λ_k, lattice offset varied by the octave number) and take Σ_k A_k · gate_k · n_k as the displacement along the normal, (4) move the vertices along the area-weighted vertex normals. Returns (V' (N,3) float64, copy of F).

• wavelengths / amplitudes: positive sequences of the same length (1 to 32 entries). Mesh units. A count mismatch, empty, 33 or more entries, a negative amplitude or amplitudes=None raise ValueError. Octaves with amplitude 0 are skipped.

• nyquist / fade / local_edge: band-gate settings (same as displacement_band_weights).

• weights: (N,) is a factor shared by all octaves, (K,N) a per-octave factor. Values are limited to [0, 1]; out of range or a shape mismatch raises ValueError.

• seed: the same seed shares the same lattice as bump_normals_fbm (octaves that the geometry cannot carry can be handed on seamlessly to the shading side).

The difference from mesh_displace_fbm is that the amplitude is explicit per octave and that the band is cut per vertex by edge length. Giving short wavelengths to a coarse mesh does not alias; they are simply ignored.
